arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test edge cases
print('=== Edge Cases ===')

# Empty result
r_empty = parse.Result((), {}, None)
print('Empty result:', r_empty)
print('\"key\" in empty:', 'key' in r_empty)
print('\"value\" in empty:', 'value' in r_empty)
print()

# Result with integer values
r_int = parse.Result((42, 100), {'count': 5}, None)
print('Integer result:', r_int)
print('42 in r_int:', 42 in r_int)
print('100 in r_int:', 100 in r_int)
print('5 in r_int:', 5 in r_int)
print('999 in r_int:', 999 in r_int)
print()

# Result with nested dict value
r_nested = parse.parse('My quest is {quest[name]}', 'My quest is to seek the holy grail!')
print('Nested result:', r_nested)
print('named:', r_nested.named)
print('\"quest\" key in r_nested:', 'quest' in r_nested)
print('\"name\" key in r_nested:', 'name' in r_nested)  # This should be False since 'name' is inside the nested dict
print()

# Using search() 
r_search = parse.search('{word}', 'hello world test word here')
print('Search result:', r_search)
if r_search:
    print('\"word\" key in r_search:', 'word' in r_search)
    print('\"test\" value in r_search:', 'test' in r_search)
"
